Name: InvoiceHours Color
Expression:
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    [Is InvoiceHours Greater] = 1, "#A2F0B7",  // Green if InvoiceHours is greater
    [Is Last Year Hours Greater] = 1, "#EEF09E",  // Yellow if Last Year Hours is greater
    "#FFFFFF"  // Default color (white)
)

Name: Last Year Hours Color
Expression:
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    [Is Last Year Hours Greater] = 1, "#A2F0B7",  // Green if Last Year Hours is greater
    [Is InvoiceHours Greater] = 1, "#EEF09E",  // Yellow if InvoiceHours is greater
    "#FFFFFF"  // Default color (white)
)

Name: InvoiceHours Symbol
Expression:
IF(
    [Is InvoiceHours Greater] = 1,
    "▲",  // Up arrow
    "▼"   // Down arrow
)

Name: Last Year Hours Symbol
Expression:
IF(
    [Is Last Year Hours Greater] = 1,
    "▲",  // Up arrow
    "▼"   // Down arrow
)

Name: InvoiceHours Symbol Color
Expression:
IF(
    [Is InvoiceHours Greater] = 1,
    "#73B761",  // Green for up arrow
    "#DB271C"   // Red for down arrow
)

Name: Last Year Hours Symbol Color
Expression:
IF(
    [Is Last Year Hours Greater] = 1,
    "#73B761",  // Green for up arrow
    "#DB271C"   // Red for down arrow
)
